pr.body:
LIVE ON MERGE: restarts the bot and lets ready account work run between complete market messages. Touches real money.

Buffered WebSocket receives can return inline on Python 3.12 and starve already-ready account reconciliation. Add one cooperative yield after all Kalshi book/trade callbacks for a message, and one after all Coinbase ticks for a message. Preserve ordering, timestamps, stale/sequence checks, deduplication and cleanup. No Polydesk/SDK edit, trading rule, order client, fee, cap, stop, resume budget, variable or persistence-cadence change. Inter-message scheduling intentionally changes; fixed-clock parity does not promise identical live trades.

Validation: 5,528 passed / 14 existing skips, captured pytest exit 0; mypy 126 source files; Ruff all four changed Python files. Includes 26 new cases and 130 focused passes: native buffered frames, complete-message atomicity, actual account-read wrapper with fake workers, stale/cutoff/sequence/timeout/failure/stop/cancellation paths. Independent review accepted exact bundle afeb6aa444d39e4f118e3b82cb50ca47bcc2c2cc1173828d737a1121bc92b040. Python 3.11 portability was reviewed but not locally executed; interrupted earlier checks are retained separately and not counted as passes.

Current production evidence still includes a 5.13-second local resumption gap; the last audited window earned 2 cents while cumulative losses remain. This change is not a profitability claim. Exact scripts, logs and limitations: research/kalshi_profitability_2026-10-14/BUFFERED_FEED_FAIRNESS.md and feed_fairness_check_receipt.json.

After merge, verify the exact Railway commit, normal Polymarket startup and retained financial state, then assess the first two consecutive complete post-restart windows using FEED_FAIRNESS_VERIFICATION.md. The execution task stays open until that recorded evidence decision; strategy comparison remains unstarted.
